title: Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor BP-220 Catalog

passages.text: The Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor (model BP-220) is a bedside blood pressure monitoring product made by Corvane Medtech.
The BP-220 measures blood pressure and pulse rate automatically at set intervals and stores up to 1,000 readings.
Standard accessories include an adult cuff, a pediatric cuff, and a power adapter.
